text: R09 supersession (2026-11-02, lead decision D4 for quest serve-eligibility-committed-epoch-read, under lead decision F10 and the owner brief of 2026-11-02, F10 reported to the owner for confirmation): in predicate (d), 'contractState != pending' is satisfied by contractState ready or under_replicated at the quorum-minimum cohort (F10: CREATE TABLE completes at the sealed quorum minimum with a typed under_replicated outcome naming the epoch and missing replica count). The rest of (d) - every partitions row has leader_node_id, at least syncReplicaAcks+1 active services rows on distinct nodes, SELECT COUNT(*) answers - and every preregistered bound stay as written. The predicate code compares contractState === 'pending' (test/distributed/harness/fresh-formation-routability-predicate.js:65,485) and is unchanged.

Supplement to the 2026-11-02 R09 supersession of predicate (d) (appended, the earlier entry is not edited): F10, on which that supersession rests, is confirmed by the owner. Owner confirmation 2026-11-02 (Peter): lead decision F10 for serve-eligibility-committed-epoch-read is confirmed. CREATE TABLE provisioning completes at the sealed quorum-minimum cohort with a typed under-replicated outcome visible to the client (contractState under_replicated with epoch and missing count, NOTICE to the client, admin envelope), answers typed PROVISIONING_UNAVAILABLE mapped to SQLSTATE 57P03 below quorum, never a silent degraded fallback or a minimum lowered to 1; this includes adding UNDER_REPLICATED to the shared OWNER_CONTRACT_STATE vocabulary (D3). The epic placement under raft-rs-full-cutover (D1) stands as a lead decision.

R09 supersession by reference (lead approval 2026-11-02; Peter's rule: test bounds are not changed): attempt 2 of replica-admission-from-committed-operation deletes CDC_DEFAULTS.CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS with the write-path cache wait. The fresh-formation predicate (g) bound keeps its preregistered value, 1000 ms, now declared in test/distributed/harness/fresh-formation-routability-predicate.js as PROJECTION_PERSISTENCE_BOUND_MS (was read from CDC_DEFAULTS.CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1000). The CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS log observation is kept (expected count zero after attempt 2). One observation is added: partition_execution_deadline, the existing typed wait that answers a routed write that cannot reach its commit; attempt 2 introduces no new wait name for commit unavailability. No other line of the reproducer changes; no bound is widened.
